line: Your phone puts a map pin inside your photos!
That pin shows where you took the photo.
Send one, and the person who gets it may see the exact place.
OpenAI says ChatGPT does not process the location saved in a photo.
It only looks at the picture itself. And a picture can still give a place away.
To keep it off, tap the send arrow, then Options, and switch Location off.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Next, I'll show you what ChatGPT does when I hide even more of the photo. Follow, so you get the full story.
